description: Tracekit: signed, hash-chained record of every tool call, with a policy gate

hooks.command: echo `# <#`>/dev/null; [ -r "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tracekit-hook" ] || { echo "tracekit plugin: the hook script did not run" >&2; exit 2; }; exec /bin/sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tracekit-hook" PreToolUse #> >$null; $LASTEXITCODE = 2; try { & "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tracekit-hook.ps1" PreToolUse; exit $LASTEXITCODE } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("tracekit plugin: the hook script did not run: $_"); exit 2 }
